title: Authentic Neapolitan Pasta e Lenticchie (One-Pot Pasta & Lentils)
ingredients: 1 cup dried brown or green lentils, rinsed
8 oz ditalini or mixed short pasta (pasta mista)
1 small onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk (blitzed in food processor into fine soffritto)
1 whole garlic clove 'in camicia' (in its skin, lightly crushed)
1 cup crushed San Marzano tomatoes or tomato passata
4 cups hot water or vegetable stock
Freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, kosher salt, and black pepper
instructions: Optional quick-start: Parboil lentils in water with a pinch of salt for 15–20 minutes, or cook everything directly in one pot.
Pulse the onion, carrot, and celery into even fine chunks in a food processor. Sweat the soffritto with the crushed garlic clove in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until sweet and golden.
Add the canned tomatoes, lentils, and hot water/broth; simmer until the lentils are tender (about 20 minutes).

Pour the uncooked short pasta directly into the simmering lentils with extra boiling water as needed, stirring frequently so the pasta starch emulsifies into a creamy, risotto-like sauce. Finish with olive oil and Parmigiano.
